entities.summary: Shinji Takeda (b. 1972-12-18, Sapporo) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Sapporo and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, composers & musicians, asia.
